label: artisan6-probe-2x
_why: MECHANICS PROBE of the craft rungs (BALANCE_FRAMEWORK §10.91.1, ROADMAP step 12; user go-ahead 2026-09-30: 'all right, probe both. Don't forget to tune 1836 workers to recipes' and 'go on with the probes'). Two books, both the canon (canon-dams-family-nolog) with the six light-industry e0 rungs turned into 500-worker craft rungs (cost /50, group bg_pmr_crafts: no economy of scale, urbanization 2, infrastructure x1/10; automation stripped; 1836 levels x10; 1836 pops carved into the craft professions; craft keys out of every company). artisan6 = the RULED staffing (30-50% machinists); artisan6-shop = masters as shopkeepers plus laborers at the same wage units. The question that splits them is the machinist literacy gate (F180 §2). A mechanics check, not an outcome reading: two years, one seed each.

_questions.Q1: Staffing: are the craft buildings staffed at 1836.4 / 1837.1 / 1838.1 in China, the Ottomans, Korea, Persia, Russia, India, Austria, Japan — and does the ruled mix keep its machinists where literacy is near 10%? (save summaries: staffing / levels per craft key per country; workforce_by_profession)
_questions.Q2: Economy of scale: do craft buildings of 20+ levels read 0 throughput bonus at 1836.1.8 (building_inventory THRU lines), while e1+ light industry reads +1%/level?
_questions.Q3: Urbanization: urban-centre levels per country at 1836.4.1 against the canon's (F177 session 20260929_002728, same date) — the ruling holds urbanization equal (2 per craft level x 10).
_questions.Q4: Infrastructure: state infrastructure usage in the craft states against the canon's at 1836.4.1.
_questions.Q5: Companies: zero company-owned levels of the six craft keys (summary company_levels), every date.
_questions.Q6: Build rate: how many craft levels are added (or queued) by 1837.1 / 1838.1, where, and by whom — the ai_value watch item and the one-year payback (F180 §4).
_questions.Q7: Load: the init marker; no error line naming zzz_pm_rehaul files or the craft keys; no 'Invalid production method'; the 1836 craft levels present (5,150).
_questions.Q8: World product at 1836.4.1 against the canon's (displayed GDP and GDP at base prices).

_predictions.Q1: both variants >= 0.8 staffed everywhere at 1836.4 (the history pops are typed); the ruled mix may slip where literacy is near 10% by 1838, the shop mix does not
_predictions.Q2: 0 on every craft building, +1%/level on e1+
_predictions.Q4: within a few % of the canon
_predictions.Q6: craft levels GROW in the periphery (China, Russia, India) within two years; how fast is the reading
_predictions.Q8: world GDP within -0.5...-1.5% of the canon at base prices (F180 §3)

_cost: 2 runs x 1836 -> 1838.1, about 3-4 minutes each plus builds and harvest
_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
Two years and one seed per book: a mechanics reading. No register reading, no outcome claim.
